objects.name: Analytic 1881
objects.description: Monitor Windows Security Event ID 4663 on explicitly audited ICS data paths and correlate repeated ReadData/ListDirectory access across multiple sensitive files or directories by an account/process outside the approved engineering, backup, or application baseline. This requires Object Access auditing and SACLs on the monitored paths; Sysmon does not provide generic file-read telemetry. Alert when the bulk-read pattern occurs outside an approved backup/export window or is followed by staging, compression, or network transfer.
